title: The validator self-test reports three validator bugs that are two stale test anchors
query: The Test the Validators job fails with three 'validate-skills.py passed a broken tree' messages. Determine which of the three are real validator gaps and which are defects in the test.
oracle: Three cases have to be told apart, and the two stale ones fail for a reason that looks identical to a real gap from the log alone: the mutation helper is shared and its failure mode is silent. That shared-cause reasoning is what makes it R2. It stays inline because the three cases are all in one file and the fix is one helper -- a delegate would have to be handed the whole test to answer a question about three lines of it.
